summary: JMAP is a JSON-based protocol for mail and related data, and it can send Web Push notifications to clients. This RFC defines how a JMAP server can advertise that it supports authenticating those pushes using VAPID, so clients can tell the notifications really come from their server.

eli5.summary: When your mail app gets a ping saying "new message," you want to know it truly came from your mail service. This gives the service a way to show its ID badge.

questions: how does jmap use vapid for web push
